newsitem.title: UK: Glencore fixes two Brent ULCCs to U.S., S. Africa.
newsitem.headline: Glencore fixes two Brent ULCCs to U.S., S. Africa.

text.p: Trading house Glencore has fixed two ultra large crude carriers, one confirmed and one on subjects, to lift Brent blend crude from the North Sea terminal of Sullom Voe to the U.S. Gulf and to South Africa respectively, shipping sources said on Monday.

They said the Marine Atlantic was fixed to lift 380,000 tonnes (2.85 million barrels, or the equivalent of nearly six standard cargoes) of Brent on March 10 to the U.S., while the Arcadia was on subjects to lift 330,000 tonnes (2.48 million barrels, or about five cargoes) on March 12 to South Africa.
Glencore dominated buying on the wet Brent market last week, picking up around a dozen cargoes or about a quarter of the March loading programme, traders said.
